cancellation_check.method: event triggered: the ordinary probe prompt (reply OK) in the CLI's streaming output mode; the whole process group is cancelled as soon as the first stream event line arrives on stdout, then proven gone (grandchildren included). No timer, no shell command or long task asked of the model.
cancellation_check.claude_argv_shape: claude -p --output-format stream-json --no-session-persistence --permission-prompts none --verbose --model haiku -- <probe prompt>, stdin /dev/null, minimal env
cancellation_check.codex_argv_shape: codex exec --json --ephemeral --skip-git-repo-check --sandbox read-only -C <dir> -m gpt-6-luna -c model_reasoning_effort="low" -- <probe prompt>
cancellation_check.claude_flag_finding: Claude Code 2.1.281 print mode refuses --output-format stream-json without --verbose (it exits with an error before any model call)
cancellation_check.inconclusive_rule: a CLI that exits before any stream event is retried up to 2 times, then fails with no_stream_event; neither runner needed a retry
cancellation_check.replaces: the previous check asked the agent to run sleep 120 and cancelled on a 30 to 60 second timer (--cancel-after, now removed)
